description: Writes to a remote service. Pins a file to IPFS; PREFER `filePath` over base64. Returns CID v1 (base32) + filename. Images are magic-byte gated to rasters and renamed `.jpeg` unless `normalizeImageExt: false`.

base64.description: Base64 file bytes — only when the content isn't a local file.

fileName.description: Filename to pin it under, with extension.

filePath.description: Absolute path to a local file, max 25 MB — the server reads it. Preferred over base64.

normalizeImageExt.description: If contentType starts with image/, rename the extension to .jpeg.

name: dexe_ipfs_upload_file

cid.description: CID v1 base32 — use this as avatarCID.

cidV0.description: Original CID returned by Pinata (usually v0 Qm...). Kept for legacy callers.

title: Upload raw bytes (avatar, attachment, etc.) to IPFS (Pinata)
